items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I hear about it, and I never get to see it. He invite me a couple times for rehearsals, something like that. He was doing something by Gene Krupa.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to be a (unintelligible). He went to (unintelligible) want to stay. I don't know. (Unintelligible) likes him. I don't know. So they got hold of somebody else.

So in the meantime Chick recommended Gene Krupa for the band, and I recommended Harry James. Well, getting around, that's the way he -- Benny start getting his men, and they used to rehearse in the Savoy. So they used to come in the Savoy one night a week at night to play right next to us (inaudible). He was trying to get the guys into a field where they see (inaudible).

So Benny Goodman, he -- and there was a big promotion, big promotion (unintelligible) the guys (unintelligible). So when they start talking about a swing and swing, and they (inaudible), and I said to me that's a gimmick. It's a title. It's a gimmick. Whoever (unintelligible) this new (inaudible) Benny Goodman the King of Swing, it's the same music we've been playing all along.
